items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Baptiste's a big family of musicians. Generically, we must be related somewhere. Okay. Or somehow.

ctx.x: The other T is B-A-T-T-I-S-T-E. There's not that many families that spell it like that here. But there is another family that's B-A-P-T-I-S-T-E. That's Baptiste. That is the original way of spelling it. The way my name is spelled is like the material.
